runtimeMapping.attacks: Original ordinary Attack .633; S2 Skill_1 .667 with uncapped animation speed; S3 Skill_2_Attack .567 with positive rate capped1. Current legal input retained by ordinary attack. Awake selector takes up to current block count and includes its blockers with priority; area aura/strike grids do not extend basic attack range.
runtimeMapping.s1: Selected DEF percentage and selected time SP; no inherited TAKE_DAMAGE auto-operation.
runtimeMapping.s2: Recovered own x-4 trigger selector arms the spin with a legal ground victim. At original hit event, RollAttack rereads all legal ground occupants and applies selected Physical multiplier with independent selected stun probability. Source active stun is before each strike; source actions then self-heal once, even if the area emptied during windup. No heal at activation.
runtimeMapping.shield: Selected initial hit count and promotion cap. Recharge every selected interval while below cap, independent of control and skill SP. Native shield_a removes recharge at full; breaking the full state restarts a fresh interval. One accepted damage receipt consumes one layer and self-heals selected current-MAX_HP fraction, ignoring noHeal and heal-free, while respecting healing modifiers. Element fill and HP loss bypass the shield path; damage refusal/dodge happen first.
runtimeMapping.s3: Native SleepAura timed wrapper maps sleep seconds to SLEEPING combo (no attacks/blocking/selection and damage immunity), with source STUN/COLD/FROZEN anti flags. Owned x-1 move-speed aura affects ground and flying legal recipients and clears immediately on leave/end. Original one-second Awake animation precedes Awake buff and ground stun; Awake lasts selected awake seconds, applies ATK/DEF and formula1 BAT percentage, and switches original attack/idle clips. Runtime duration includes the mapped Awake animation gate.
runtimeMapping.sarkaz: Native filtertag reduce_damage uses MODIFIER_SOURCE and no damage-type/apply-way filter. Apply selected nonstacking source-tag cut to HP damage; sourceless damage, unrelated sources and HP loss do not inherit enemy credit as a source.

verificationLimits: Native compiled Sequence/TimedAbility animation-finish and buff-attachment dispatch are not executable. Sleep starts at cast, ends after selected sleep, then mapped original Awake animation gates the Awake buff. This adds one second to selected sleep+awake runtime. Exact engine phase overlap and in-game frame parity are not claimed.

Native S3 Stun selector generic max_target resolution and rangeIdUsage routing are not executable. The mapped game-table surrounding-ground stun and own attack range/block-count cap are explicit; the recovered full original selector graph remains available for further verification.

Native shield_a/b/c and same-priority callback dispatch are collapsed to one ordered hit count. Damage-final consumption is mapped after dodge/refusal, before foreign barriers; zero HP-damage receipts reaching that path consume one layer. Same-frame foreign shield/heal interaction is unverified.

S2 buff_prob dispatch uses one selected independent chance per current RollAttack victim before its damage. Source child-ability dispatch and mixed dodge/kill recursion remain bounded; one heal follows the completed area pass.

Native combo1 SLEEPING and anti flags0/12/16 use pinned buff database identities. Automatic abnormal-state classifications, existing-control attachment and aura cadence are local mappings. Owner status immunity is restricted to the literal three source anti flags.

Original Back lacks S3 Begin/Sleep/Awake clips. Those recovered Front animations are used through the transition, then the original Back awake attack/idle can resume. Missing Back clips are not invented; native fallback facing is not frame-verified.
Native particles, sounds, shield layer visual tiers and effects are retained as source references but not rendered. Modules and unreviewed cross-operator interactions remain disabled.
